Willow Wood Ward - September 2026

A Message From The Bishopric

As September comes in and school routines are kicking in, our ward and others are preparing for a new Sunday schedule. Meetings in Sunday School, Quorums, Relief Society, and youth classes every week down to 25-minutes. This change is a clear reminder that the heart of gospel learning belongs in the home. Sunday classes are meant to encourage discussion, but the primary teaching happens in our daily lives at home. During the General Conference in 2018, President Russell M. Nelson taught: ​"The new normal is to have a home-centered, Church-supported curriculum... It is time for a home-centered Church, supported by what takes place inside our branch, ward, and stake buildings." ​The Lord promised the peace that comes when Gospel learning is centered in the home. 3 Nephi 22:13 says, “And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord; and great shall be the peace of thy children”. ​As we adjust to the changes, we invite each of you to lean into home study by: Regular Scripture Study: Take a few minutes for daily scripture reflection around the table in the morning or before bed(Anytime works). Bringing Insights to Church Meetings: Come ready to share the simple truths you learned at home during the week to help contribute to the shorter class discussions. Praying: Keep personal, family, and marital prayer at the center of your busy schedules. ​ Thank you for your faith and dedication as we make this transition together.
